description: This file implements the core functions for the TLS Session Manager Object, including engagement, cancellation, and timer invocation functions for session management within a TLS protocol implementation.

classes.name: PTLS_SESSION_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the TLS Session Manager Object, managing session lifecycle and timers.

classes.name: PTLS_SESSION_ENTRY_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing an individual TLS session entry, including timestamp and cleanup logic.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts the patrol timer to engage session management activities; sets the object to active.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Stops the patrol timer and deactivates the session management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoPatrolTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Iterates through TLS sessions, removing expired sessions based on timestamp and timeout.
